name: movie_betelgeuse_isi_chromatic
label: Movie: Betelgeuse's TiO-band (650 nm) against near-continuum (900 nm) diameter with the ISI line, three nights
notes: The target's chromatic_diameter table draws a 12 % larger disk at 650 nm (TiO bands) than in the near-IR continuum and 2 % larger at 900 nm; the runner fits the diameter per wavelength and reports the ratio and its significance.

At 650 nm the 47 mas TiO disk has its null at 3.45 m, so the trucks at their 2.5 m minimum spacing sit on the first lobe (|V|^2 0.2-0.55) and the 5 m pair in the first sidelobe. Expected: theta(650) to ~2.3 %, theta(900) to ~1.5 %, ratio 1.10 +/- 0.03.
